tests.title: every selector result and panel carries one provenance tag, and the baseline is labelled "Sample data, illustrative"
a group of fewer than 5 is never shown, in any role, dataset, section, period or site
the group-size rule can be raised in Settings but never lowered below 5
one dataset per view: a cohort view holds no case-backed figure, a case view holds no cohort figure, exports never mix
administrator and supervisor get aggregates only: no clinical text in their state, no drill-down, no patient initials in the digest
direct support gets no analytics; a supervisor counts only their own sites
the clinician digest equals what the clinician would compute from their own state
a payer decision moves the unresolved count, the awarded units and the offers waiting (S5 → S6)
a request that is sent moves "sends with receipts" (S3 → S6)
a processed note moves notes on time, and a draft with a failed check moves items caught early (S1 → S6)
the CSV prints exactly what the panels print, with period, filters, dataset and definitions
the PDF is a valid multi-page document carrying the same cells, the dataset, the period and the definitions
the question box answers from the data on screen, says so when it cannot, and labels itself Simulated
no story date is written into the analytics code (the demo clock is the only source)
admin: three sections render, aggregates only, no drill-down, no console errors, within the density target
clinician: drill-down opens the patients behind a group; the cohort offers none
supervisor: own sites only, scorecard and sections render
a filter changes the figures and the URL; a tab is a real link; reload keeps the view
the CSV file the Export button writes matches the panels on screen, cell for cell
the PDF export downloads and the question box answers on screen
the old payer playbook link (?panel=guidance) opens the payer guidance drawer from Payer Performance
earlier views stay reachable and the scorecard opens its detail
queue: nine columns, four open cases sorted by deadline, each deadline carries a source chip, rows are links to the case
old routes keep working and hand over: Partials, InfoRequest, PeerBrief -> the case; Partials (no id) -> the queue filtered
S5 by clicking: D.W. partial -> evidence and options -> peer-to-peer -> outcome 130 -> back to the authorization with the stage Active
K.T. information reply: Evidence-missing blocks review, an edit clears it, Send opens the mock Availity page and the case closes when the page confirms
admin: the queue and the case show status and deadlines; no clinical text reaches the page
keyboard and dialogs: tabs and rows are reachable, the dialog traps focus, Escape closes it and focus returns
1024 px and 390 px: no horizontal scroll on the queue or any section
every request.stage maps to the chip group of the status vocabulary (one mapping, tested)
the queue: chips overlap, counts follow the other filters, a draft is also a renewal, an overdue request is also submitted
v3 deep-link names (show=, st=, exp=, range=) become the canonical filters
deadlines carry a source: day counts from the rules table, Harvest-reported, never a bare 7 or 14
roles: admin sees status, units and the queue but no evidence text; direct support has no queue
owner and backup: set by anyone who opens the queue, visible to admin, the backup must be a different clinician or supervisor
the follow-up call log is append-only, needs the send capability, and a confirmed receipt is kept once
a payer decision needs its document reference and a plausible date; it is write-once
approved: Active, the award in the tracker (not Lauris), and the human task "Enter units in Lauris" opens
the task closes only when the open Lauris page shows the units: a forged event, or no action at all, cannot close it
partial and denied: the stage follows, the appeal window comes from the rules table
reconcile: units approved at 150 on T.N. replace the 65, and T.W. is not Active without units
the queue: no demo buttons, chips with counts, URL state, v3 links, sort, search, Denial Intelligence links
S3 R-0416: Review packet -> Approve (Pending clinical approval) -> Sign in Lauris -> Send -> Submitted with the Sfax receipt
the timeline: events open What · When · Who · Document · Source · Next action; ?section= opens that section
Record decision: approved opens the Enter units in Lauris task (card with the Lauris link); Psyflo does not write units; admin sees the task read-only
a supervisor may approve once designated (two people confirm it); the approval is recorded under the supervisor, and a different person can send
case actions on an overdue request: Log call, Overdue notice (no legal standard cited), Send again with a reason, Change owner
old routes keep working: Submission and EarlyDischarge land on the case sections; legacy=1 opens the old screen
direct support has no Authorizations; a missing or foreign case says so instead of failing
sections by role, and a hand-typed section can never open what the role may not see
fail closed: no actor, no list; direct support cannot see another person's day; nobody in scope is nobody (no default person)
clinician: urgent first (24-hour information reply), verbs per item, referrals in their own section
administrator: operations only, no clinical items and no clinical text anywhere
supervisor: review queue is the staff routed to them and never their own notes; designated sending shows Send notice
direct support: one progress line, next overdue note first, due-next list, no tiles of other people
the note deadline comes from the rules table: 24 h by default, changing it changes who is behind
the server refuses what the screen hides: admin and direct support cannot review a note; a reviewer cannot review their own
clinician lands on To do: top three with verbs, Show all expands, tabs carry counts, one h1, no console errors
supervisor lands on Review: approve a note, return one with a required note, approval mode in Team
Team deep link ?staff= opens that person's day; the old StaffDashboard and ReviewQueue routes land here
administrator: Operations and Team, "Clinical text hidden for your role", no note text, review is denied with the reason
direct support: My day only, one progress line, Write note goes to the form; works at phone width without sideways scroll
a row whose screen the role may not open says why (a disabled button), never a dead link
every link on every My Work section, for every role, resolves to a screen the role may open
roles: a raise needs a second person (not the proposer, an administrator or a clinician); a lowering applies at once; never your own
people: new users start as direct support or supervisor; clinician and administrator go through a role change
designated access: proposed by an administrator, confirmed by someone else, never for yourself, never a clinical-record grant for an administrator
rules: a reason is required, only the administrator edits, the type is kept, and a change is audited with its values
rules: the dependent screen changes (day-5 follow-up makes the Aetna request a follow-up call in My Work); reset restores it
units: the alternate bands change the units a day earns; restore returns the official bands (audited)
signature mode per document type: default remote (not validated); In person changes the rule the family screens read
family link questions: ask and required switches (the guardian link reads them); the insurance question is locked
the administrator has no clinical-record access: Settings never carries note text, and the matrix says so
Settings: seven tabs, one h1, every tab renders without console errors; only the administrator opens it
rules tab: filter by source, search, edit in the drawer (reason required, value type kept), history and the audit tab show it
units tab: the try-it box follows the bands; switching to the alternate asks why and is audited
roles tab: the matrix is drawn from permissions.js; designate in the UI, the clinician confirms from My Work, the grant takes effect
people tab: change a role with a reason (a lowering applies, a raise waits), the second person confirms in Settings or My Work
family tab: In person changes the rule, asks why, shows Policy not validated; the family-link question switches work
presenter tab: how it fits, architecture, maturity legend with all four levels, the unresolved decisions with where each is set
Login: four role cards, the family and school entries, no password, no demo chrome; signing in lands on the role's home; works at 390
token pairs: every text pair 4.5:1, every UI pair 3:1 (computed in the page from tokens.css)
type floor and brand: DM Sans, paper background, 12 px smallest kit size, teal primary
status vocabulary: every stage and dispute status resolves; chips carry text and an icon (never colour alone)
maturity chips: Working is hidden until the presenter overlay is on; Simulated, Pilot and Future always show
modal: role=dialog, aria-labelledby, focus trap both ways, Escape, scrim click, focus return
drawer: same contract as the modal
popover: Escape closes it and focus returns to the control
confirm resolves true on Confirm and false on Cancel; the toast has role=status (alert for errors)
the old modal(html, onMount) helper is now an accessible dialog (screens keep working)
filter chips: aria-pressed, state in the URL query, survives a reload, Clear
search keeps focus while typing and filters rows
queue table: aria-sort, sort toggles, real links, ArrowDown moves between rows, Enter opens
queue table: sticky header, empty, loading and error states
evidence chip opens a popover with the quote and closes on Escape
timeline: an event opens a drawer with What, When, Who, Document, Source, Next action
draft review: edit text survives repaints; no bulk accept; Restore previous appears after a save
a store change (SSE) while someone is typing does not wipe the field; the repaint waits for blur
skip link is the first tab stop and moves focus to the main landmark
landmarks: <html lang>, a labelled nav, exactly one main, real links in the rail
focus moves to main on a route change and the route is announced
the old demo bar is gone from the product viewport
rail: light sand, 232 px wide, collapses to icons at 1024; counts only where meaningful
rail by role follows the permission table (supervisor, clinician, admin, direct support)
dock: hidden by default in Presentation, Ctrl+Shift+P toggles, label PRESENTER, mode always visible, above the viewport
dock: ?present=1 opens it; ?mode=explore docks it open (no hide control) and is stored in psyflo_mode
dock: role switcher changes the signed-in role without a page reload
dock: scenario selector calls demo.scenario, signs in as the scenario role and opens its route
dock: simulation controls (receive a reply, advance a day) live in the dock
dock: notes drawer "How the data gets in" with maturity chips, focus returns to Notes
dock: All screens picker is role-aware and searchable
UiKit is presenter-only: without the dock it says so; with ?present=1 it shows the gallery
prefers-reduced-motion: overlay animation is switched off
no console errors on the gallery, the stubs and the shell routes
registry keeps every historic route id and pre-registers the new routes
redirect table matches review/04-architecture.md E1 and 03-ux-audit.md e
referrals are never redirected away; AppealLetter and every portal route stay put
every redirect has a flag, a registered target and no cycle; every flag is used
with every flag on, every historic deep link still resolves to a registered route (no dead ids)
legacyFor maps a not-yet-live new route back to the old screen that does the job
